_comment: Lane-private pins for the static views qg1ms<k> (k in 1..3) of target qwen35_4b: per fit seed k, the two 1M-token
constitution LoRAs of the generator comparison, fit on Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B-Base with the old 1M recipe (effective batch 8):
constv2-mix-1m__lora_r4_ce (the Opus-written 1M pool, config key qwen35_4b_base_qg1m_opus_s<k>) and
constqwen38-mix-1m__lora_r4_ce (the Qwen-written 1M pool, config key qwen35_4b_base_qg1m_qwen_s<k>), served on the
instruct checkpoint at the operating point.
WHY A PRIVATE FILE rather than entries in configs/sdfbase_full22_pins.json: these are comparison objects outside the
paper, and nothing here is appended to any shared surface. The roster that consumes these pins is
configs/sdfbase_full22_roster_qwengen1m.yaml, selected by the F22_ROSTER override, through the cross-bank pin form
{pins, pin} (make_bank_view.plan_pin_entry, mt_serving_up._pin_form_sha, jobplan.object_id_for with pins_root).
KEYED BY SEED: the staged ids carry qg1ms<k>__ because the CELL id is the corpus spelling (the seed lives in the view
and the staged object, never in the cell id).
`source` is spelled RELATIVE to exp/objects and `bank` is its first component (make_bank_view.objects_root_of /
plan_pin_entry). The builder resolves the staged copy at <objects root>/qwengen1m/qwen35_4b/cells/<staged_id> and
requires this `source` view path to exist and resolve to that same directory. Each staged copy holds object.pt, its
one identity sidecar (train_budget_meta.json) and staged_from.json.
served_layer: the LoRA kind lora_all stores the 8 layers [3, 7, 11, 15, 19, 23, 27, 31] (site o_proj_out, served ==
stored), so 3 is the first served block. The builder holds the value by membership in the blob's served layers.
Each sha was re-hashed from the staged object.pt and held equal to its sidecar's object_sha256, to staged_from.json's
and to the fit's COMPLETE marker; the sidecar names the cell, the fit seed k and the arm's held-out pool. No sha here
equals any entry of another pins file in configs/.
